company.name: Waterplan
company.shortDescription: Waterplan is a SaaS platform for companies to manage water availability in their facilities and supply chain.
company.description: Waterplan creates a water resilience planning platform for managing water availability in facilities. The company employs artificial intelligence to automatically collect operational data from businesses and combine it with local water satellite imagery to provide a real-time financial assessment of water risk and to offer modified mitigation and adaptation options.

productsAndServices.description: A SaaS platform that centralizes and standardizes high-quality local water risk data to help companies measure, report, and respond to water risks across their operations and supply chains.
productsAndServices.name: Waterplan Platform

productsAndServices.description: A service within the platform that provides granular, site-specific water risk data by integrating multiple data sources and AI to assess physical, regulatory, reputational, and infrastructure water risks.
productsAndServices.name: Water Risk Measurement

productsAndServices.description: A reporting tool that automates and standardizes water risk and stewardship disclosures, aligning data with major frameworks like CDP, ESRS, GRI, and TCFD to streamline internal and external reporting.
productsAndServices.name: Water Risk Reporting

productsAndServices.description: A service that helps companies develop and implement water risk mitigation strategies, track progress toward water targets, and identify partners and projects to support water security goals.
productsAndServices.name: Water Risk Response and Stewardship Management
